name: Elevated plus maze
description: A raised plus-shaped maze with two open and two walled arms. Measures anxiety-like behaviour: anxious animals avoid the open arms and stay in the closed arms.

parameters.label: Arm length
parameters.help: Length of one arm from the edge of the center square to the arm tip. It is only used to check the drawn zones, not in the calculations.

parameters.label: Arm width
parameters.help: Inside width of one arm. It is only used to check the drawn zones, not in the calculations.

parameters.label: Tracking gap tolerance
parameters.help: If the animal is lost for longer than this, the movement across the gap is not counted. Raise it only for low frame rate videos.

zones.label: Center
zones.geometry: Central square where the arms meet.

zones.label: Open arms
zones.geometry: Both open arms, one shape per arm.

zones.label: Closed arms
zones.geometry: Both closed arms, one shape per arm.

inputEvents.label: Risk assessment
inputEvents.definition: A scored stretched-attend or head-dip posture.

events.label: Center visit
events.definition: Contiguous counted intervals whose earlier sample is in center.

events.label: Open arms visit
events.definition: Contiguous counted intervals whose earlier sample is in open_arms.

events.label: Closed arms visit
events.definition: Contiguous counted intervals whose earlier sample is in closed_arms.

events.label: Center entry
events.definition: Later sample time of a counted interval entering center.

events.label: Open arms entry
events.definition: Later sample time of a counted interval entering open_arms.

events.label: Closed arms entry
events.definition: Later sample time of a counted interval entering closed_arms.

metrics.label: Analyzed duration
metrics.description: Time during which the animal could be tracked.
metrics.definition: Samples and calibrated zone shapes use the same coordinates in centimeters; zones are evaluated independently and include their boundary. A counted interval is a pair of consecutive tracked samples with 0 < dt <= max_sample_gap_s.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Distance traveled
metrics.description: Total length of the path the animal walked.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Time in center
metrics.description: Time spent in the central square where the arms meet.
metrics.definition: Counted time whose earlier sample is in the center.
metrics.formula: sum(dt where earlier sample in center)
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Time in open arms
metrics.description: Less time in the open arms suggests more anxiety-like behaviour.
metrics.definition: Counted time whose earlier sample is in an open arm.
metrics.formula: sum(dt where earlier sample in open arms)
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Time in closed arms
metrics.description: Time spent in the walled arms.
metrics.definition: Counted time whose earlier sample is in a closed arm.
metrics.formula: sum(dt where earlier sample in closed arms)
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Share of time in open arms
metrics.description: Part of the analyzed duration spent in the open arms; a lower share suggests more anxiety-like behaviour.
metrics.definition: Share of analyzed duration in open arms.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Share of time in closed arms
metrics.description: Part of the analyzed duration spent in the closed arms.
metrics.definition: Share of analyzed duration in closed arms.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Open arm entries
metrics.description: How many times the animal walked into an open arm.
metrics.definition: An entry is a counted interval whose earlier sample is outside the zone and whose later sample is inside.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Closed arm entries
metrics.description: How many times the animal walked into a closed arm; often used as a measure of general activity.
metrics.definition: An entry is a counted interval whose earlier sample is outside the zone and whose later sample is inside.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) when there is no counted interval.

metrics.label: Latency to open arm
metrics.description: Time from the start of the trial until the animal first reaches an open arm.
metrics.definition: Time of the first tracked sample inside the zone, from the trial start.
metrics.formula: first tracked sample time in open arms
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (EVENT_NOT_OBSERVED) when no tracked sample is inside the zone; missing (NO_VALID_INTERVALS) without counted intervals.

metrics.label: Risk assessments
metrics.description: Number of scored stretched-attend postures and head dips.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when risk assessment was not scored.
